utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve heard it’s getting organized, but I’m still catching up on the details. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still checking the details, but the main things are the loose front steps and a leaking gutter by the hall. Once I confirm the full list, I can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps. So it’s mainly the front steps and the gutter by the hall, and you’ll share the full list once it’s confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Tell me what still needs doing for the repair drive, and I’ll keep track. I’ve got the details and school schedule options lined up, so we can match them up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sam can handle the scouting, and Jules can keep folks lined up and updated. I’ll send over the locations that still need checking.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I’ll keep track of Sam’s scouting and Jules’s updates. Send the locations that still need checking, and I’ll line them up with the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah. Come by whenever works for you, and I’ll have the tools ready for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus. I’ll swing by later today and check what else the repair drive needs.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah. I’ll set aside the tools and make a short list of anything else the repair drive still needs.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik, could you give me the quick version again? I don’t want to mix up the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, quick version: we’re collecting repair needs, lining up the volunteers, and I’ll keep passing the plan along to everyone I run into.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, got it. I’ll start gathering the repair needs and let you know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help sort out who’s been waiting the longest and flag them for you. That should make it easier to start with the right homes this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, can you confirm you’ll flag the longest-waiting homes this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, I’ll flag the longest-waiting homes this afternoon and send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m on it now, and I’ll drop by with the repair drive details so you can pass them along too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I can take those details after I finish my errands and pass them along. Just let me know what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Ira. I’ll bring you the latest list so you can help spread the word once you’re back.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll send a few names and a time that works for me.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo. Send them over, and I’ll check whether I can make that time work.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll send the names and a couple time options shortly.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help line people up and keep folks posted on what still needs doing. If you have the latest details, I can help spread them around.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules. What exactly still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I don’t have the full list yet, but I can help gather it and let everyone know what’s still open. Once you share the details, I’ll spread them around and line up whoever can help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive list ready and I’m lining up the first homes for this afternoon. If you can flag anyone who’s been waiting the longest, I’ll make sure they’re first in line.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll check the list and flag the folks who’ve been waiting longest. Send me the names, and I’ll get them to you right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I’ll send the names over now. Thanks, Rey, that’ll help me get the first round set before this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s looking busier this afternoon, so maybe come by a little later if that’s easier. I can let you know if the timing shifts.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That helps, thank you. I’ll wait for your update and pass along the repair drive details when you send them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good, I’ll keep you posted if the timing changes. Thanks for helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m still waiting on the latest count. If you have it, tell me how many sign-ups are in and which tasks are still open.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I don’t have the latest count yet, but once it comes in I’ll pass along the sign-ups and the open tasks right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, send it as soon as you get it, and flag anything urgent first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, send me the brief version and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can keep it brief: Opal is coordinating the logistics and tracking the outstanding pickup locations. Tell me what you need me to bring or handle.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I can help with pickups or hauling if needed. Send me the remaining locations and I’ll take one.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m getting the word out about the repair drive now, and I’ll bring you the details so you can pass them along too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, confirm the details with me when you have them, and I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll confirm the details and bring them by soon so you can share them too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is picking up again this week, and I can swing by after errands to drop off what I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That works great, Ira. I’ll keep passing the repair drive plan along so folks know they can drop things off this week.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good, that should help a lot. I’ll bring my drop-off after errands and keep an eye out for anyone else who wants to chip in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Rey. Let’s make a clear list of what’s needed for the repair drive and tackle it one step at a time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That works. Send me the list and I’ll help sort it out one step at a time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll write up the list now and bring it over for us to review.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What exactly needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I need the repair drive details first, then I can line it up with the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it. Please send the repair list and any dates you already have, and I’ll check it against the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard the repair drive is coming together, but I’m still missing the details. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m still skimming the details too, but I can help once you send the schedule and the remaining tasks.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I don’t have the schedule yet either, but I’ll send along whatever I hear on the remaining tasks.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m lining people up and keeping track of what still needs doing. I can send the latest once I’ve checked who’s covered and what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m mostly thinking the loose back gate and that flickering porch light still need attention. Once you’ve got the latest, I can help fill whatever’s still open.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That matches what I have so far. I’m checking who’s covered now, and I’ll pass along anything still open so you can grab a spot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I missed the details, but I can check in and see what's needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot. I’m happy to come by, I just need to know what time makes sense so I don’t miss the busy part.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’ll check on the timing and let you know as soon as I can. I don’t want you to miss the busy part either.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam. Could you scout the main drop-off spots and tell me which ones still have room for the repair drive items?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can check the main drop-off spots and report back on which ones still have room.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Leo. Please include the spot names and roughly how much room each still has for the repair drive items.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I’ll pass it along when you bring the details by.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, I’ll bring the details by and check in with Opal about the pickup locations.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I appreciate you checking with Opal too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, it’s looking busier this afternoon with a few more drop-offs coming in. If you’re heading over, it may be better to come a little later so you’re not waiting around.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many sign-ups are confirmed now, and what still needs to be set up before I come over?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I don’t have the exact count yet, but there are a few confirmed drop-offs now and it’s still filling up. They’re just getting the table and sorting area ready, so later this afternoon should be smoother.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I was meaning to bring that up, just give me a sec to remember the details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No rush. I’ve got the list handy, and I’m trying to sort the homes that have waited the longest first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo. If you read me the first few, I can help sort them out and keep track as we go.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can lend a hand with that. Tell me what you need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus. I’ll send you the repair drive details, and if you can help track what still needs doing, I’ll keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Mara. Send it over and I’ll help keep track of what’s left and what I can bring.
